body:
Scope: fresh independent final whole-change Code Review after both M1 and M2 and all required corrections completed. Complete engineering range e861676350c7a8fdc8b3b8ea69c8d4068cefd3a7..cfae277f3225de7fefa2812ca4ba646d6eee6e89; all 48 changed engineering subjects are recorded below. The unchanged ModelRecordTests module is an additionally inspected audit basis. Earlier milestone assessments informed this review but did not substitute for fresh complete-scope and cross-milestone assessment.

Integrated trace and ownership: current approved proposal, diagnostic-clarified Test Design, affected Workflow Design and V7-clarified Delivery plan remain the exact governing basis. M1 implements Test criteria in portable selective applications and eleven/eight consumer groups, while the five governance references retain internal ownership traceability. Actual specialist judgments remain under Review and Closeout; Test is not an approval service or evidence-applicability authority. Conditional resources avoid unrelated mandatory reading, private IDs and contributor paths in public flows. Historical boundary formats, specialist methods, stored contracts, release history and external permissions remain explicitly preserved. Current generated candidate metadata reflects those resources, with no command/schema/version change.

Fresh cross-milestone assessment: the M2 maintenance applies the M1 published quality/maintenance rules rather than merely reducing test count. It identifies canonical mirror completeness and bytes as the obligation, strengthens the retained full-tree assertion with an independent rglob oracle before deleting the overlapping proposal-only execution, retains path/byte diagnostic value, and accounts for the one missing method. It keeps all model subtest partitions and distinct output/default-root, helper/public, missing/stale, historical, authority and side-effect boundaries. Protection does not depend solely on the builder's collector or on similar test names. The revised full-mirror test also freshly exercises the resources introduced in M1, so consumer packaging and actual cleanup proof remain coherent.

TG-FINAL-01 manual comparison: meaningful diagnostic-only localization is permitted with an explained contribution, while renamed repeated assertions are not; helper proof cannot stand in for public behavior; a flaky sole regression with missing intended authority is preserved and routed; lost discovery is a proof gap, not successful faster validation. Legacy unlabeled and randomized tests retain justified obligations/counterexample context instead of becoming deletion candidates automatically. Required replacement detection precedes reliance on removal, uncertainty preserves protection, and compatibility retirement requires an owner decision. These expectations agree across models, selected specialist guidance, recorded audit dispositions and actual test changes. No semantic-judge automation, blanket historical migration or test-count target was introduced.

All ten Code Review dimensions pass: approved requirement/non-goal alignment; direct meaningful test and manual scenario coverage; scoped edge/combined-hazard treatment; fail-closed unknown/missing/drift validation; coherent criterion/assessment/storage architecture; historical/customer compatibility; public privacy and execution authority; current canonical/mirror/archive outputs; bounded unrelated-change exclusion; and adequate applicable actual proof. The complete bounded audit covers 18 original methods plus partitions, resulting in 17 retained methods across its two classes, with a justified consolidation rather than loss of required distinct protection. No material finding, unresolved necessary decision or omitted engineering milestone was identified.

Proof assessed: M1 canonical validation 20, skill regressions 373, mirror baseline 8, all three current adapter archives and full adapter suite 158, npm 654 total/652 pass/2 existing skips; M2 baseline/after scoped classes 8/10 then 7/10, strengthened test before deletion, isolated missing/changed/extra fault detection and complete post-change modules 7/87. The probe's earlier import-path failure was corrected, and its missing-file corruption may fail at an earlier explicit existence assertion; the retained test's detection and inspected independent dictionary comparison support the bounded protection claim without overstating that probe. M1 package proof remains applicable to unchanged resource/builder/dependency/environment inputs, while changed M2 tests have fresh proof.

Final actual command evidence: bash scripts/ci.sh --mode pr --base e861676350c7a8fdc8b3b8ea69c8d4068cefd3a7 --head cfae277f3225de7fefa2812ca4ba646d6eee6e89 --jobs 4 --timeout 900 passed all 17 selected full-range checks, including model/boundary, skill regressions/generation/drift, adapter drift, exact-revision lifecycle, metadata, guide/prose, selector, CLI and publication tests. Inspected durable final-ci result and current subjects. The separate local wrapper's four checks cover only its since-M1 scope and are not treated as complete-branch proof. I independently checked full-range whitespace and reexamined committed integrated scope. These are local command results, not a hosted CI claim or successful Verify.

Recorded historical subject identities stay truthful; complete-scope reliance is based on current subjects and semantic evidence, not matching hashes alone. Final review recording changes no engineering subject and does not automatically invalidate unchanged evidence, but new contrary results or engineering edits still require applicability assessment. Verify must now perform its own complete evidence/coherence and concern-disposition assessment before success-only explanation and completion. This final engineering judgment does not itself authorize an external action or renew Verify.
independence_basis: A separate delegated nonauthor agent /root/independent_proposal_review executed this fresh final assessment after both implementation milestones closed. codex-author authored all engineering changes and audit evidence; this reviewer authored only independent review records. The same independent reviewer earlier assessed milestones, but this execution freshly examined the complete committed change, public criteria-to-maintenance interaction, exact authority and final full-range proof; no milestone judgment was relabeled as final approval.
